title: Pre-Ilyas Shah Regional Bengal Sultanates
subtitle: Competing regional courts before Bengal-wide unification.
summary: Before Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah unified Bengal, multiple regional sultanate centers operated in Lakhnauti, Sonargaon, and Satgaon, producing fragmented yet dynamic political competition.
heroTagline: Competing regional courts before Bengal-wide unification.
whyItMatters: This stage clarifies how unification in 1352 emerged from earlier regional power struggles, not from a political vacuum.
